native_review.summary: The exchange was ultimately completed correctly: the user was authenticated via name and zip code, the delivered digital camera order was located, the appropriate max-zoom replacement variant was selected with PayPal payment, explicit confirmation was obtained, and the exchange was processed. The main issues were: the user's opening message was mistakenly role-played as an agent message, and the agent repeatedly violated the policy by making multiple tool calls at once (turn 10) and by sending user-facing text together with tool calls (turns 15, 25, and 29). These violations did not affect the final outcome.

errors.reasoning: The user simulator's first message ('I'd love to help with that exchange! Let me pull up your order...') is phrased as if the user were the agent, asking the customer for email/order number. This contradicts the customer role and the simulation guidelines, which require the user to act as a customer and disclose information progressively.
errors.correct_behavior: The user should have greeted the agent as a customer and stated the reason for the call, e.g., that they received a digital camera and want to exchange it, waiting to provide identity details only when asked.

errors.reasoning: The agent made four get_order_details tool calls in a single turn and combined them with a user-facing message. This violates the policy that the agent should make at most one tool call at a time and should not respond to the user and make a tool call in the same turn.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one tool call at a time, waiting for each response before issuing the next, and should not have sent narrative text alongside the tool calls.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message ('Let me look up the available options...') and made a get_product_details tool call in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent should not respond to the user and make a tool call simultaneously.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should either have sent the explanatory message and waited for the next turn, or made the tool call without accompanying user-facing text.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent the user-facing confirmation ('You've confirmed all the details.') and then made the exchange_delivered_order_items tool call in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent should not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have either sent the confirmation message first and made the tool call in a separate turn, or made the tool call without adding user-facing text in the same message.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing explanation and then made the transfer_to_human_agents tool call in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent should not respond to the user and make a tool call simultaneously.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the transfer tool call first and then, in a separate turn, sent the required transfer message to the user.

auth_classification.reasoning: The agent requested identity verification (name and zip code), the user provided Sofia Li and zip 78260, and the agent successfully looked up the user via the find_user_id_by_name_zip tool, retrieving the user ID and details. The agent then confirmed 'I've verified your identity successfully.'
